extracted.intended_audience: EU citizens and stakeholders interested in contributing to EU law-making
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance on how citizens and stakeholders can contribute views and engage with the European Commission during the policy cycle (preparation, proposal, evaluation) using official mechanisms such as the public consultations portal, the European Citizens’ Initiative, and the Citizens’ Engagement Platform.

rubrics_metrics.name: Opportunities to contribute throughout the policy cycle
rubrics_metrics.description: There are various opportunities to contribute to EU law-making as it evolves – from the preparation phase through to proposals for new laws and evaluations of how existing laws are performing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Citizens can contribute at multiple stages (preparation, proposal, evaluation). They may use public consultations and other feedback mechanisms and can consult related documents as well as the contributions received.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public Consultations portal (single entry point)
rubrics_metrics.description: Public Consultations and feedback is a single portal for citizens and stakeholders to give their views on the Commission’s initiatives and contribute to the decision-making process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Commission's Public Consultations portal to submit views and feedback on specific initiatives; the portal serves as the primary channel for stakeholder input to influence decision-making.

rubrics_metrics.name: European Citizens’ Initiative (ECI) — call for legislative proposals
rubrics_metrics.description: Using the European Citizens’ Initiative, EU citizens can call on the European Commission to propose legislation on topics within its competences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The ECI is a mechanism for citizens to request that the Commission consider proposing legislation; it applies only to topics within the Commission's competence and follows the ECI procedural requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Citizens’ Engagement Platform — deliberative discussion space
rubrics_metrics.description: The Citizens’ Engagement Platform serves as a dedicated space for citizens to engage in European-level discussions regarding important upcoming EU proposals that affect us all.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Participate in the Citizens’ Engagement Platform to discuss and provide input on upcoming proposals at a European level; the platform is intended for deliberation and crowding-in stakeholder perspectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Better Regulation agenda — aim to increase participation
rubrics_metrics.description: Increasing the participation of citizens and stakeholders in the law and policy-making is an important goal of the Commission's Better Regulation agenda.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contributions and engagement are encouraged as part of the Commission’s broader objective to make regulation better through wider stakeholder and citizen involvement; this frames the purpose and expected value of participation.
